title: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:25534:20140806:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 25534, August 6, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force after ten days have elapsed from its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.) Public notifications, dispositions, or other acts performed by the head of a former local government or the head of an affiliated agency in connection with an area incorporated into another local government under this Decree before its enforcement shall be deemed acts performed by the head of the local government or the head of the affiliated agency that acquires jurisdiction over the area. Applications, reports, and other acts submitted to or performed before the head of the former local government or an affiliated agency shall similarly be deemed submitted to or performed before the head of the local government or affiliated agency acquiring jurisdiction.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes or Regulations) Where another statute or regulation in force at the time this Decree enters into force defines as its area or jurisdiction all or part of the Gun area altered by this Decree, the altered area shall, until that statute or regulation is amended after the enforcement of this Decree, be deemed to belong to the former Gun area for purposes of applying that statute or regulation.
